limits: Saved SSE cannot remeasure client TTFT: only recorded monotonic-clock implementation, nonnegative value and wall-time range are verified.
Server TTFT and effective prefill/decode rates are recomputed from saved server counters, not an independent wall-clock recording of GPU operations.
Incoming API token IDs are not exposed: native fixed token hashes, exact prompt/request bytes and actual server token count are checked; byte-for-byte API token ID identity is not claimed.

Natural short answers, early EOS before a requested capacity condition, missing needle values and pair mismatches remain visible. Literal needle presence is not a proof of correct associations, complete answers, or general quality.
Three formal repeats are summarized by their full samples and median/min/max; no confidence interval or p95 is inferred. Warmups are excluded.
This audit does not re-read model payloads or recompute Windows telemetry; those have separate evidence.
